gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that ZippingIterator.remove() correctly delegates removal to the underlying single iterator, keeping the backing list consistent.
ADDED i2: Wraps a single list in a ZippingIterator and removes all multiples of 4. Verifies that the backing list shrinks by exactly the number of removed elements.
